§6Powercell (High)§f

§a40× the Low's capacity. The final form of modular RF storage.§f

The §bPowercell (High)§f holds §e20,000,000 RF§f and transfers §e4,000 RF/t§f per side. A full 9×9×9 network pushes §e729,000 RF/t§f per side. That's enough for any reactor in the pack. Each upgrade preserves 100% of stored energy via Copy NBT.

§6Upgrade§f: Copy NBT recipe, §bPowercell (Medium)§f + §b4× Power Core (High)§f + §b4× Redstone§f.

Same wrench I/O, wireless linking, and energy retention as the lower tiers. Wireless linking works across dimensions too, so a High network can feed remote bases.

§cWARNING:§f Stockpile diamonds and emeralds. A 9×9×9 High network eats hundreds of cores.
